title: Vanilla, Done Right
description: A lightweight, client-side modpack that improves performance, usability, and visuals
body:
# Vanilla, Done Right
[Install Guide](https://support.modrinth.com/en/articles/8802250-modpacks-on-modrinth)

Vanilla, Done Right is a lightweight Fabric modpack focused on performance, clarity, and quality-of-life, while keeping Minecraft feeling exactly how it should — vanilla.

No overhauls. No feature creep. Just Minecraft, smoother and smarter.

## ⚡ Performance First

We use proven performance mods like Sodium, Lithium, and Entity Culling to:

- Dramatically increase FPS
- Reduce stuttering and CPU load
- Improve performance in mob-heavy and technical builds

These mods work quietly in the background to make the game feel faster and more responsive, without changing gameplay.

## ✨ Subtle Visual Improvements

Visual tweaks are kept minimal and vanilla-faithful, enhancing the game without altering its style. Shaders are included!

## 🧰 Quality of Life

A small selection of quality-of-life mods improves everyday gameplay, such as:

- Cleaner debug and UI elements
- Better inventory interactions
- Helpful information without clutter

## ✅ Why Vanilla, Done Right?

- ✔ Client-side & Fabric
- ✔ Multiplayer-friendly
- ✔ Low memory usage
- ✔ Designed for daily play

If you love vanilla Minecraft. This pack is for you.
